incidents-bot: Paging @oncall - elevated 5xxs on /v1/embeddings from us-east-1, sustained spike, tail errors ~10% over 5m. Incident ID INC-2026-83
Liam (oncall): Ack, I'm looking now.
Maya: I'm finishing handoff in ~3m, quick triage: is this customer-impacting? Grafana shows failures concentrated on embeddings hot-route and a few heavy customers spiking concurrency.
Ben (runtime): Logs show OOMs on embedding-worker pools (emb-rt-64). Pattern looks like KV-cache thrash when many long-context requests come in. Model variant quant4 causing memory pressure.
Priya (sre): If we don't act, tail latency will keep rising. Recommend immediate per-endpoint quota surgery: lower global embeddings QPS by 30%, per-customer concurrency caps, and temporarily disable rerank fanout that amplifies traffic. Chat route should remain untouched.
Liam (oncall): Agreed. Ben, can you prepare the rate-limit patch? Priya, can you scope the tmp rule for the edge? I'll coordinate comms.
Ben (runtime): Preparing patch now. Proposed config snippet:
```
route: /v1/embeddings
  global_limit: 2000rps
  per_customer_limit: 100rps
  burst: 200
  duration: 60s
  action_on_breach: 429
```
Applying to canary now.
deploy-bot: Rate-limiter config rl-20260315-1 applied to edge-proxy-canary (canary id c-71).
Maya: Noting: this will throttle embeddings-heavy customers, may increase latency for queued requests but prevents timeouts. CS please flag customers >80% failure for follow-up. @Emma can you draft messages?
Emma (support): Will draft and send list in 10m. I'll include suggested mitigation steps (reduce batch sizes, retry jitter).
Ben (runtime): Also rolling out a lightweight quant variant for embeddings for the heaviest tenants as a temporary fallback (traffic split 90/10). Watch for metric regressions on vector quality.
Priya (sre): Post-change metrics: error-rate dropped to ~2.1% in 4m, CPU on emb-rt-64 workers down ~35%. Leaving limits for 30m then reassess.
Liam (oncall): Good. Handoff to night oncall @Noah in 20m. Please monitor for queued request growth and SLO breaches.
Noah (next-oncall): Ack. Added runbook link to incident: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/embeddings-qos and I'll keep eyes on alerts.
Maya: I'll open a follow-up incident ticket for RCA and capacity plan; also track permanent per-route quotas and autoscale tuning. :white_check_mark:
